meta: Hotel receptionists use AI to talk with guests in many languages: Korean and Japanese guests can still be served well.

muc.title: Three guests, three languages
muc.text: Korean and Japanese guests stand at the desk together, and a receptionist who only speaks English can still help them with AI.

muc.title: Translate at the desk
muc.text: Turn on the voice mode of a chatbot, an AI chat assistant; guests speak their own language and AI translates instantly.

muc.title: Common phrases ready
muc.text: Ask AI for greetings, breakfast hours and wifi instructions in several languages, printed as cards at the desk.

muc.title: Documents and payments
muc.text: Don't photograph guests' passports into AI. For room rates and fees, double-check the guest understood correctly.

muc.title: Check-out time in three languages
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to translate "check-out is at twelve noon" into three languages, with pronunciation.
